Its loose, breezy fit helps keep you cool and looks effortless no matter whether you keep it casual or dress it up. 64% TENCEL™ Modal, 36% COOLMAX® EcoMade polyester. Care instructions for reds and blues: Dark colors rub off on light colored fabric and upholstery. Wash before wearing. Machine wash cold with like colors on gentle with mild detergent. Do not use fabric softener. Non-chlorine bleach. Tumble dry low. Cool iron. Can dry clean. | Care instructions for all other colors: Machine wash cold with like colors on gentle with mild detergent. Do not use fabric softener. Non-chlorine bleach. Tumble dry low. Two-piece stand collar. Embroidered team logo on the chest. Jacquard fabric weaves pattern into the design rather than being printed on the surface. Wrinkle resistant. Coconut Point: These camp shirts wick away moisture to help you feel cool, while feeling just like silk without any of the care restrictions. IslandZone®: Moisture wicking, quick drying, travel ready. Smaller Footprint: This style contains TENCEL™ Modal fibers made from a renewable, sustainable source of raw material wood. | Disclaimer: TENCEL™ is a trademark of Lenzing AG. Imported. ST326617NF
